exposure: Interaction between maternal SARS-CoV-2 infection and GDM
cohort: The study included 378 hospitalized pregnant women with SARS-CoV-2 infection, matched with pregnant subjects free of SARS-CoV-2 or GDM, enrolled between November 2022 and January 2023.
finding: The coexistence of maternal gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) and perinatal SARS-CoV-2 infection was associated with an increased probability of neonatal SARS-CoV-2 infection.
